editorial:
Ever felt like the bad guys always win because of a loophole in the law? That is exactly what you get with Inspector Amar Kaushal. He is a straight-shooting cop who does everything by the book, but he quickly realizes that the system is broken. His bosses are lazy and the lawyers are slick, meaning the criminals he catches just walk right out the front door. It is a classic setup that makes you root for the hero as he hits his breaking point. The vibe is heavy on grit and frustration, making you feel the weight of the injustice along with him.

What really works here is the tension as Amar stops playing by the rules and starts acting as judge, jury, and executioner. The action is punchy and the drama feels real for the time it was made. While some of the plot twists are easy to guess, the emotional payoff is great. If you love old-school justice movies, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older gem, try to find a high-quality version to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the details clearly.
endingExplained: In the final act, Amar stops trusting the courts entirely and creates his own street-level justice system. He hunts down the criminals who escaped the law, including those who framed him. After a series of intense fights and confrontations, he eliminates the main villains once and for all. The movie ends with a strong message that when the official law fails the innocent, a brave person must step up to clean up the streets.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s action and stories about vigilante justice.
